main.description: Issue an EIP-4361 (SIWE) message for the caller to sign with an Ethereum EOA or Coinbase Smart Wallet-compatible account. Caller must already hold a valid session (passkey-first policy, ADR-0074) that resolves to an ERC725 root identity. The returned message embeds the wallet address, the configured private chain ID, a server-issued nonce, and an expiration. The nonce is single-use and tied to the caller's ERC725 root DID; legacy did:etzhayyim/did:web values are accepted only as facade lookup inputs.

statement.description: Optional human-readable statement to embed in the SIWE message

message.description: EIP-4361 SIWE message to sign with personal_sign

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch seconds when nonce expires

errors.name: RootIdentityRequired
errors.description: Caller is still on an unmigrated legacy DID with no ERC725 root facade link

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.description: address is not a valid 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex string

errors.name: ConfigError
errors.description: ETH_PRIVATE_CHAIN_ID or AUTH_DB is not configured
